name: [UPDATE!] Asura
desc:
Asura is a PVP focused game where players train to become the strongest. Pick one of the many different martial arts & show off your moves.

Show support by favouriting & liking the game.

We update regularly so make sure you join our community server linked below.

Solidify your legacy & become the Asura Champion!

Controls:
Q = Dash (Can dash twice)
M1 = Punch/Clashing
M2 = Block Break
F = Block/Perfect Block
WW = Run
E = Toggle Run/Sprint
,  =  Waypoints
Commands:
!trade {playername} - Trading
